claim: Preview the existing raw CLI splice-actor reference replacement; no new native caller, actor class, device family, physical effect, whole-file or SPS claim.

existing_source_basis.relationship: Authoritative already supported CLI behavior, including permissive type handling, first-match traversal, warning-only source admission, sparse connector creation, Nc and page flags.
Unmodified selector, bracket-room filtering, UUID mirror de-duplication, ambiguity and error behavior.
Unchanged normal JSON/table reporting, report-before-save ordering, overwrite, unconditional save and content-change-dependent stamp behavior.
Existing fail-closed dispatch contract. Only ConfigCmd::SpliceActor is newly admitted.
Existing private immutable plan, raw presence/spelling, format and early-return conventions only; no mood or native count semantics enter splice-actor.

hash_basis: SHA256 and Git blob OIDs above describe committed baseline LF blobs, not CRLF working-tree bytes.
provenance_boundary: No native splice caller is claimed. Existing repository implementation is the proof for this CLI-only preview. Native connected-binding contracts describe different operations and are not repurposed as splice or physical-effect evidence. No corpus extraction or new native execution was performed.

shared_plan.application: One immutable plan resolves selected and actual target paths, source spelling, AI attributes, ordered reference attributes, Nc and optional sparse creation/Nio. Writer applies it directly, without a second resolution. Preview never applies it or clones a DOM.
shared_plan.reuse: The original source warning, target resolution, page/flag and target warning prelude is extracted as wire_connector_target and shared with wire_connector. Existing selector, connector direction, page, connector map, UUID and owner helpers are reused. The variadic I3..I20 branch cannot apply to the fixed AI key; it remains unchanged for wire_connector.
shared_plan.no_new_support: No new source selector, alias, actor/device/type guard, connector normalization, reference resolution or wiring framework.

preserved_semantics: require_one(selector) precedes any source warning or target lookup. Exact Type=OutputRef selects itself; otherwise first direct Co K=I or AI containing an In with Input is followed. Missing Input is skipped, empty Input is not.

Owner lookup is the first C owning a direct Co K=AQ with the exact stored actor Input UUID. Its type is not checked. Then uuid:owner is resolved again with the existing selector helper, including mirror de-duplication and errors.
Source is not resolved as a title or block. Strip one literal leading uuid: before trim. Input and unknown connectors warn but remain admitted, including empty and cross-file UUIDs.

First direct Co K=AI only. All its direct In children are removed, including malformed ones and their payload. Non-In children and later duplicate AI connectors remain. New In is appended, Nc becomes 1, append is false.

Before reference attributes retain all raw Input/FLG and extra attribute spellings and missing-versus-empty distinctions. child_index records direct child order; discarded_children counts removed nested payload, not a complete XML diff.
FLG=2 iff both known pages differ or source page is unknown, using the existing helpers exactly. Otherwise the new In has no FLG.

Missing AI uses the same embedded connector map, default and generated UUID as the old writer. Preview marks the proposed connector UUID ephemeral; it is not a promise of identity across invocations. Nio is counted only in this existing creation branch.

No-op source spellings do not suppress replacement or normal save. Document stamping still uses the normalized content_changed comparison, so a true reference no-op keeps its stamp. Normal reports strip uuid: but do not trim, while the stored reference is trimmed, as before.
All existing save-as overwrite, destination-error and report-before-save behavior remains after the early-return branch.
preview_boundary: Returns before DOM mutation, XML serialization, default insertion, Document stamp, save, destination probing or directory/cache/network/telemetry writes. Only local source input read/parse/resolution and diagnostic output occur. JSON has dry_run and optional trace_id; table/CSV use JSON-valued cells for lossless presence and spelling. Quiet suppresses only summary; no-header affects table/CSV headers.
tests: src/config_edit/wiring.rs::splice_actor_tests: read-only planning, selector and first-source resolution, raw/duplicate/malformed references, same/cross/unknown pages, sparse creation, permissive non-OutputRef owner, ordered failures, low-level writer equivalence and no-op transitions.
tests/dry_run.rs::splice_preview_reports_actual_resolution_raw_references_and_output_formats: selected actor/target/source, warnings, trace and table/CSV/JSON/quiet/no-header behavior.

tests/dry_run.rs::splice_preview_all_destinations_and_failures_preserve_files_network_and_telemetry: complete sandbox contents/mtime/permissions snapshots with telemetry locally enabled and all network traffic directed to a local observer; missing/input/existing/missing-parent destinations and malformed/missing/ambiguous inputs; wire aliases remain fail-closed.

tests/dry_run.rs::splice_preview_errors_keep_legacy_validation_and_warning_order: selector, missing UUID, unwired actor and first-source failures precede source warnings; eventual target ambiguity or missing AI follows the existing warning.

tests/dry_run.rs::splice_normal_writer_keeps_raw_report_overwrite_noop_save_and_conditional_stamp: unchanged writer report shape/raw spelling, existing destination overwrite, BOM/CRLF, unconditional no-op save with unchanged stamp, changed-content stamp and save-failure order.
Existing config integration, wiring unit and dry-run suites, followed by the four workspace gates recorded in the delivery artifact.
